funFacts: Energy cannot be made or destroyed - it only changes form.
A solar panel turns sunlight into electricity.
Plants store the Sun's energy as chemical energy in their food.
A light bulb gives out heat as well as light - that is why it feels warm.
Your body turns the chemical energy in food into movement and heat.
A loudspeaker turns electrical energy into sound energy.
A battery stores chemical energy that can become electrical energy.
Rubbing your hands together turns movement energy into heat.

levels.name: Solar & Lunar Eclipses

questions.back: When the Moon passes between the Sun and the Earth and blocks some or all of the Sun's light. It happens only at a new moon.
When the Earth passes between the Sun and the Moon, so Earth's shadow falls on the Moon. It happens only at a full moon.
The umbra is the dark, central part of a shadow. The penumbra is the lighter outer part of the shadow.
Total (the Moon completely covers the Sun), annular (the Moon is farther away and leaves a ring of Sun), and partial (only part of the Sun is covered).
Total (the Moon is in Earth's umbra and can look red - a 'blood moon'), partial (only part of the Moon is in the umbra), and penumbral (the Moon only dims slightly).
NEVER look directly at the Sun - not even during an eclipse. Use special eclipse glasses or a solar viewer. Sunglasses are not enough!
The Sun's glowing outer layer. You can only see it during a total solar eclipse, when the Moon hides the bright disc of the Sun.
